priorityList.notes: Ambush out of a Vanish before anything else.
Slice and Dice up at any combo points, refresh at 5 when it is about to drop or when Adrenaline Rush is waiting on a longer one.
Adrenaline Rush anchors the big window. Cast it low on energy so none of the extra regen is wasted.
Blade Flurry is auto attack speed and does not feed the energy window, so it goes on cooldown.
Cold Blood is spent by the next hit, so only ever right before a 5 point Eviscerate.
Gnome. Eureka! on cooldown, the next 3 abilities cost 20% less and hit 10% harder. Other races can ignore the warning on this line.
Orc. Blood Fury waits for Adrenaline Rush when the wait costs no use. Other races can ignore the warning on this line.
Night Elf. Elune's Light waits for Adrenaline Rush when the wait costs no use. Other races can ignore the warning on this line.
Troll. Berserking is auto attack speed, so it goes on cooldown. Other races can ignore the warning on this line.
Earthstrike on cooldown. Without the trinket ignore the warning on this line.
The synthetic on-use trinket on cooldown. Without the trinket ignore the warning on this line.
Thistle Tea when there is room for the 100 energy.
Goblin Sapper Charge on cooldown once Slice and Dice is up.
Goblin Land Mine right after a main hand swing, so its 1 sec cast loses no swing time.
Anything not listed above (trinkets).
Vanish for an Ambush at low combo points.
Night Elf: Shadowmeld into Ambush, as the Vanish line. Other races can ignore the warning on this line.
Ambush from stealth after Vanish, or when Cutthroat lets it go out after a Backstab.
Preparation resets Vanish (and Cold Blood) for a second Ambush once the first is spent.
Backstab.
